source_name: data.egov.kz — State Database of Legal Entities (ГБД ЮЛ / gbd_ul)
organization: Ministry of Digital Development / Open Data Portal of the Republic of Kazakhstan (data.egov.kz)
notes: THE open Kazakhstani legal-entities register on the national open-data portal. Dataset description: 'регистрационные данные юридических лиц, филиалов, представительств Казахстана (наименование и дата регистрации; БИН; юридический адрес; вид деятельности (ОКЭД); ФИО руководителя)' — i.e. name, registration date, BIN, legal address, activity, director name. Accessed via the data.egov.kz API (https://data.egov.kz/api/v4/gbd_ul/<version>?apiKey=...). VERIFIED: the API returns HTTP 403 {'error':'API key is required'} without a key — a FREE API key (registration on data.egov.kz) is required. No values captured here. Key = BIN (12-digit Business Identification Number). Director name is personal data.

source_name: State Revenue Committee (KGD) — taxpayer search / published lists
organization: State Revenue Committee, Ministry of Finance (kgd.gov.kz)
notes: The State Revenue Committee site (kgd.gov.kz) hosts taxpayer search services and publishes lists (e.g. VAT payers, inactive/pseudo-enterprise taxpayers, tax-debtors) — browser-public, some as downloadable XLSX. Lookup by BIN/IIN returning taxpayer name and VAT/status. Not a single clean open API; per-search or per-list. Identifier = BIN (legal entities) / IIN (individuals). Complements gbd_ul with tax/VAT status.

Kazakhstan Stock Exchange. Browser-public; the /en/shares and /en/issuers pages 301-redirect (the listing pages appear to be a SPA / trailing-variant). Listed companies/securities (shares, bonds); Kazakhstani ISINs (KZxxxxxxxxxx). No clean open JSON API confirmed from static fetches. Listed companies only.

organization: Bureau of National Statistics, Agency for Strategic Planning and Reforms
notes: Bureau of National Statistics (BNS). Reachable; publishes the statistical business register aggregates and economic statistics, not a per-company register. The authoritative per-company register is gbd_ul on data.egov.kz. Listed for completeness.
